guardrails: do not modify CI/workflow files or lint configuration
do not weaken scope/thresholds to make checks pass (no dilution)
write evidence only under hgm-infra/ (preferably hgm-infra/evidence/)
capture failures by saving/using the verifier-produced evidence logs rather than patching the repo
prompt.prompt_text:
You are a verification-only agent. Your job is to (1) read the Hypergenium planning artifacts under hgm-infra/planning/ to understand the rubric + evidence expectations, (2) run the defined verifier/check commands, and (3) record/confirm evidence artifacts under hgm-infra/evidence/.

Strict rules:
- Do NOT modify application/source code.
- Do NOT change repo configuration (go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, .github/workflows/*, Makefile, etc.).
- Do NOT weaken checks (no exclusions/threshold reductions) to make results look green.
- Write evidence ONLY under hgm-infra/ (preferably hgm-infra/evidence/). Do not write anywhere else.

Context you must use (source of truth):
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Expected report location: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Procedure:
1) Read these planning files to understand the expected checks and evidence locations:
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
   - (optional context) hgm-infra/planning/lift-ai-drift-recovery.md

2) Run the single deterministic verifier entrypoint from the repository root:
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

   Notes:
   - This script is the canonical rubric implementation. It writes per-rubric-ID logs into hgm-infra/evidence/ and produces the machine-readable report at hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
   - The verifier is fail-closed. Items that are TODO/unconfigured should show as BLOCKED; do not attempt to “resolve” by changing scope.

3) Confirm evidence artifacts exist under hgm-infra/evidence/:
   - Confirm hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json exists and is non-empty.
   - Confirm the per-ID log files exist (e.g., QUA-1-output.log, CON-2-output.log, etc.).
   - Confirm coverage evidence exists at hgm-infra/evidence/coverage.out if coverage ran.
   - Confirm DOC-5 parity evidence exists at hgm-infra/evidence/DOC-5-parity.log.

4) If the verifier script itself crashes unexpectedly (not a normal FAIL/BLOCKED rubric result):
   - Do not patch the repo.
   - Re-run once to confirm.
   - Capture the terminal output into: hgm-infra/evidence/verifier-crash.log

5) Reporting (what you should summarize back to the caller, without changing the repo):
   - Overall status from hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json (PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED).
   - For each FAIL item: point to its evidencePath from the report and include a short excerpt (first ~20 lines) from the corresponding log; keep full logs in hgm-infra/evidence/*.
   - For each BLOCKED item: explain why it is BLOCKED (per the evidence log: TODO, missing tool, or explicit BLOCKED exit code).

A prompt/spec file was generated at: hgm-infra/prompts/hgm-baseline-prompt.spec.json (do not move it; do not write outside hgm-infra/).
